title: Assurance Beacon: Checklist & Ownership Lattice for SOC2/ISO/SSO Cutovers
creator: Maya Chen
description: Purpose: Create a lightweight, repeatable artifact (the 'Assurance Beacon') that consolidates the next 6 checkpoints required to take a set of compliance/security tasks from engineering backlog to audit-ready state. The Beacon combines a concise checklist, a responsibility lattice (who owns verification vs who provides evidence), and a rolling checkpoint calendar that aligns with sprint cadences and release windows. Scope includes SOC2 Type II readiness items, ISO27001 control mappings for Release C and the SSO/SAML cutover for the Console, plus audit-log retention verification for Dedicated and Private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: A single page Assurance Beacon doc exists in Confluence with versioned sections for SOC2, ISO27001, and SSO cutover
Ownership lattice populated: for each checklist row there is an owner, reviewer, and evidence consumer (names + team)
A 6-week rolling checkpoint calendar (biweekly sync + gating windows) published and linked to Linear cycles
Templates for audit artifacts (log extraction query, config snapshot checklist, SSO test script) are added to the Beacon
Sign-off flow defined: who approves gateway closure for each control; runbook for fallback to previous rollouts
plan: Week 1: Draft Beacon skeleton and control mappings. Week 2: Workshop with SRE, Security, and Console PMs to populate ownership lattice. Week 3: Add evidence templates and log verification scripts; run a smoke audit against a staging Dedicated pool. Week 4: Publish Beacon, seed next two cycles with checkpoint owners, and run first gate review. Post-publish: collect feedback and iterate (sprint retro). Mapping artifacts: Confluence page + linked GitHub PR for test scripts + dashboard query saved in Grafana.

notes: Design decision: keep Beacon intentionally lightweight (one page + linked artifacts) so engineering teams can attach it to PRs during rollout. Future iteration: add automated checks that update lattice status via GitHub Actions and Grafana alerts.
risks: Risk: Ownership lattice drift if roles change — mitigation: quarterly owners audit and auto-notify owners 2 weeks before checkpoints
Risk: SSO blackout timing can delay customer-facing releases — mitigation: define emergency rollback criteria and simulate a cutover in staging
Risk: Evidence extraction scripts might not cover older dedicated clusters — mitigation: test matrix across 3 historical revision images
